newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK POVAZSKE TO LAUNCH SKK 600MLN BOND.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK POVAZSKE TO LAUNCH SKK 600MLN BOND.

text.p: Povazske strojarne a.s. engineering company, formerly one of Slovakia's leading arms makers, said on Friday it will launch a five-year 600 million Slovak crown bond issue.
The bond, with a nominal value of 50,000 crowns, will carry an annual coupon of 12.6 percent paid half-yearly, a statement issued by the company said.
The rate of the issue is set at 100 percent of the nominal value. Neither the lead manager nor the date of issue were immediately avaliable.
The bond will be used to finance energy conservation systems and a new tractor gear-box line.

It will also be used for the modernisation of a non-ferrous metal pipe line and investments into production capacities for manufacturing roller bearings, rubber industry machinery and a new power generating system, the statement said.
